core_idea: Lobotomy E.G.O::In the Name of Love and Hate Don Quixote is a Damage Dealer / Support — **Minus Coin** identity gated by SP: below 0 SP she swaps to **negative SP** skills (Where are… the villains…?, …) with far higher Base Power than the Plus Coin set. Scaling conditions: +30% damage per Magical Arcana (max +90%). Support passive (**Magical Power Charging Support**) buffs teammates.
playstyle_guide:
- **Minus Coin kit** — at 0+ SP you run **positive SP** Plus Coin skills; below 0 SP you swap to **negative SP** Minus Coin alternates (Where are… the villains…?, Get out of my head…, …) with much higher Base Power.
- Deliberately drain SP with Minus Coin skills and avoid SP healing until you are in **negative SP** — missing SP adds up to +20% damage on Base Skills.
- **Magical Power Charging Support** — align allies' actions with the passive's trigger condition.
- Build Love — Hate Count — spend via S3 once you hit 2+.
- Reach scaling conditions before committing S3: +30% damage per Magical Arcana (max +90%).
- Hold S3 for when At 2+ Love — Hate is met — that condition is what unlocks its full damage ceiling.

**S1 — By Manager Esquire's Orders, I Am Here!** (BP 3, CP +4, x2): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low).
- Consume 5 Love — Hate Count on self to gain Coin Power +1; [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 2 Love — Hate (max 2); [On Use] Gain +3 Love — Hate Count
- Gain +2 Love — Hate Count; [On Hit] Inflict 2 Rupture

*↳ Alternate S1 — Where are… the villains…?* (BP 12, CP -4): rolls — low 12, high 20 (Extremely High).
  - Gain +2 Love — Hate Count

**S2 — With Love! Hyah!** (BP 6, CP +5, x2): rolls — low 6, high 16 (Average).
- Deal +12.5% damage for every Love — Hate on self (max 75%) ; [On Use] Consume 6 Love — Hate Count on self to gain Coin Power +1 ; [On Use] Gain +5 Love — Hate Count
- Gain +4 Love — Hate Count
- Inflict 2 Rupture; [Heads Hit] Inflict Mark of Villainy against the main target next turn

*↳ Alternate S2 — Get out of my head…* (BP 15, CP -6): rolls — low 15, high 27 (Extremely High).
  - Gain +3 Love — Hate Count

**S3 — Arcana Beats!! / Minor Arcana Slave!!!** (BP 5, CP +4, x3): rolls — low 5, high 17 (Average / Extremely High stacked).
- Peak output requires both conditions: Deal +30% damage for every Magical Arcana on self (max 90%) | [On Use] At 2+ Love — Hate, deal +(Love — Hate x 25)% damage (max 125%).
- Up to **+90% damage** (+30% per **Magical Arcana**) — stack the resource before committing.
- converts coins to Unbreakable under condition

*↳ Alternate S3 — Reversed Beats / Reversed Arcana Slave* (BP 20, CP -6): rolls — low 20, high 38 (Extremely High).
  - Unbreakable Coin

Combat passive — **In the Name of Love and Hate - !ALERT: E.G.O GEAR SYNC THRESHOLD EXCEEDED!**: Gain 1 Love — Hate every time this unit consumes 10 cumulative Love — Hate Count in this Encounter.
  - Encounter Start: if this unit does not have Hysteria, gain Hysteria.
  - Encounter Start: if this unit does not have Love — Hate, gain Love — Hate.

Defense skill — **Guard: Rapid Chant**: Clashable Guard.
  - [On Use] Base Power +1 for every Hysteria (max 3).
  - [On Use] Gain +4 Love — Hate Count (2 times per turn).
